cache_policy: Raw archives are a local download cache, never committed. The freezer resolves them under the ACS scratch area (%LOCALAPPDATA%\acs\scratch\gleif-snapshot on Windows, ~/.cache/acs/scratch/gleif-snapshot elsewhere) or GLEIF_CACHE_DIR, re-downloads and re-verifies each archive by SHA-256 and byte count, so an absent cache is a normal first-run condition.
notes: Archive hashes describe the downloaded ZIP bytes. The canonical dataset was built from this frozen snapshot by scripts/build_gleif_dataset.py and is fingerprinted by canonical_dataset_sha256; frozen-snapshot.json records the extracted CSV names, 338-column LEI2 header, and reported row counts. No blind split has been scored. GLEIF license and data format are documented at the linked official sources.
